# UI Shell Checklist: RWA Wizard UI Shell

**Purpose**: Lightweight author self-review of the UI shell requirements for completeness, clarity, consistency, and scenario coverage before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-03-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required screens and surfaces explicitly defined beyond the wizard itself, including the draft list, target selector, review stage, and generation handoff states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-001A, §FR-007, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK002 Are the draft-management requirements complete for create, resume, rename, delete, autosave, export, and import, without relying on plan-only details? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008A–§FR-008G]
- [x] CHK003 Are the target-catalog requirements complete for enabled, hidden, and visible-disabled targets, or is one of those states only implied in the contracts/plan but not fully specified in the feature requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001A, §FR-001B, §FR-013A–§FR-013C, Contract: Target Catalog]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec explicitly define the deliverables for the component inventory and mock gap register, rather than only naming them as artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-014A, §FR-017, §FR-017A, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is “meaningful content” for initial draft persistence sufficiently defined, or does it need clearer criteria to avoid ambiguous empty-draft behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008G, Contract: Draft Storage]
- [x] CHK006 Is the phrase “same spirit as the UI Builder wizard experience” precise enough for autosave and draft-list behavior, or should the spec state the exact user-visible expectations directly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008D]
- [x] CHK007 Is “fully functional target” specific enough for Stellar, or should the spec clarify whether it includes all review/export/generation flows plus module availability and validation coverage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013A]
- [x] CHK008 Are the terms “temporary mock,” “documented mock,” and “mock gap register” defined consistently enough that implementers can tell when real integration is required versus optional? [Clarity, Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-017A, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK009 Is “macro-level structure and screen composition patterns of the prototype” measurable enough to guide implementation and review without inviting pixel-perfect restyling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §FR-020A, §FR-021]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do the storage requirements in the spec align with the plan and draft-storage contract on import behavior, autosave, and failure handling, with no conflicting assumptions about merge vs new-draft flows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008A–§FR-008G, Contract: Draft Storage, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK011 Do the target-selector requirements align across the spec, plan, and target-catalog contract on whether future ecosystems are visible-disabled versus hidden? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001A, §FR-001B, §FR-013B, §FR-013C, Contract: Target Catalog, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK012 Do the codegen-boundary requirements consistently keep chain-specific validation and artifact generation out of the UI shell across the spec, plan, and codegen-service contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-010A, §FR-016, Contract: Codegen Service, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK013 Are the ZIP-generation requirements consistent between “downloadable ZIP as primary outcome” and any fallback/error wording, without implying both successful generation and failed delivery at the same time? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009A, §FR-011A, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can the success criteria for draft persistence, generation handoff, and target selection be objectively checked from the written requirements, or do they rely on unspoken reviewer judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002–§SC-004, §SC-007, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK015 Is the shared-component outcome measurable enough to distinguish “reused existing component,” “local candidate,” and “promoted shared component with example coverage”? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014, §FR-014A, §FR-018, §FR-019, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK016 Do the requirements define enough observable outcomes for a lightweight first iteration, or are some expectations pushed only into the plan/contracts where they could be missed during implementation? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Requirements, Plan §Project Structure]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are primary, alternate, and exception flows all covered for draft lifecycle actions: create, resume, rename, delete, export, and import? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are target-selection scenarios fully covered for initial load, disabled-target visibility, unsupported-target blocking, and future-target readiness changes? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, Spec §FR-001A, §FR-001B, §FR-013A–§FR-013C]
- [x] CHK019 Are generation scenarios fully covered for success, unavailable real integration, mock-backed fallback, and download-delivery failure? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-009, §FR-009A, §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-011A]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are boundary conditions defined for storage corruption, quota exhaustion, invalid imports, and deletion confirmation, or do some rely only on contract notes instead of feature requirements? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract: Draft Storage]
- [x] CHK021 Are boundary conditions defined for unavailable compliance modules and target capability changes in a way that makes the resulting wizard state unambiguous? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK022 Does the spec clearly state what remains editable after a generation error, storage failure, or invalid import so recovery expectations are not left implicit? [Recovery Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §FR-011A, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are first-render selector responsiveness, autosave non-blocking behavior, and browser-side ZIP responsiveness specific enough to guide implementation without inventing extra performance assumptions? [Non-Functional, Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK024 Are privacy and client-only constraints sufficiently specified for identity-related draft data, or should the feature requirements state explicit warnings/handling instead of leaving them mostly to the constitution? ## Dependencies & Assumptions

## Ambiguities & Conflicts
